{{Top|leg}}
'''"Those who came before"''' was the term used by the [[Sebiri]] to describe an advanced [[Species/Legends|species]] who they believed had created the jungle on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sebiris]], and performed miracles with the aid of glowing charms. They also built a [[stone temple]] in the planet's equatorial region without the use of tools.
